name: Jetvault Backup & Speed Optimizer
author: Jet Vault Dev

sections.description:
Jetvault Backup & Speed Optimizer is the ultimate solution for protecting and accelerating your site. It combines a powerful backup system with professional-grade database maintenance tools to keep your site running at peak performance.

Key Features:
* One-Click Backup: Create complete backups of your database and files with a single click.
* Instant Restore: Roll back your site to a previous state in seconds if anything goes wrong.
* Database Cleanup: Remove post revisions, auto-drafts, spam comments, and transient data to reduce database size.
* Database Optimization: Defragment and optimize database tables for faster queries.
* Automated Maintenance: Schedule backups and cleanups to run automatically at your preferred intervals.
* Detailed Logs: Monitor every optimization and backup process with clear activity logs.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the jetvault-backup-optimizer folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in your admin dashboard.
  3. Access the settings via the ‘Jetvault’ menu in your admin dashboard.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

Yes, all core features are free and ready to use.

Where are my backups stored?

Backups are stored securely in your wp-content/uploads/jetvault-backups/ directory.
